pilot_decision.basis: The existing product configuration, API contract and QA routes consistently list usa first. This is reversible before editorial publication.

ht.title: Kòmanse ak objektif la, pa ak yon pwomès
ht.summary: Pwosesis la depann de rezon vwayaj la ak sitiyasyon moun nan. Sèvi ak zouti ofisyèl yo anvan ou pran yon desizyon.

en.title: Start with the purpose, not a promise
en.summary: The process depends on the purpose of travel and the individual situation. Start with official tools before making a decision.

ht.title: Pou kiyès li ka adapte
ht.summary: Pa gen rekòmandasyon jiskaske kritè lang, bidjè, fanmi ak objektif yo gen metòd ak sous.

en.title: Who it may suit
en.summary: No recommendation is published until language, budget, family and goal criteria have a documented method and sources.

ht.title: Pou kiyès li ka pa adapte
ht.summary: Baryè yo dwe dekri san estereyotip epi ak diferans ant eta ak vil yo.

en.title: Who it may not suit
en.summary: Barriers must be described without stereotypes and with state and city differences made explicit.

ht.title: Chemen migrasyon
ht.summary: Kategori yo varye selon objektif ak enfòmasyon pèsonèl. Se sèlman sous ofisyèl ak pwofesyonèl otorize ki dwe sèvi pou evalye kalifikasyon.

en.title: Immigration pathways
en.summary: Categories vary by purpose and individual facts. Eligibility must be assessed through official sources and authorized professionals.

ht.title: Reyalite kominote ayisyèn nan
ht.summary: Bezwen entèvyou modere, konsantman, echantiyon ak diferans rejyonal anvan piblikasyon.

en.title: Haitian community reality
en.summary: Moderated interviews, consent, sample disclosure and regional differences are required before publication.

ht.title: Travay ak revni
ht.summary: Pa pibliye salè oswa dwa travay san otorizasyon, eta, vil, peryòd, sous ak dat.

en.title: Work and income
en.summary: Do not publish wages or work-right claims without authorization context, state, city, period, source and date.

ht.title: Pri lavi
ht.summary: Ranje yo bezwen pwofil kay, vil, dat ak yon metòd ki ka repwodui.

en.title: Cost of living
en.summary: Ranges require a household profile, city, date and reproducible method.

ht.title: Bank ak lajan
ht.summary: Egzijans kont, frè ak kredi dwe sòti nan sous regilatè oswa kondisyon aktyèl founisè a.

en.title: Banking and money
en.summary: Account requirements, fees and credit information must come from regulators or current provider terms.

ht.title: Lojman
ht.summary: Gid la dwe separe rechèch pratik ak dwa ki chanje selon eta ak vil, epi mete verifikasyon anvan peman an.

en.title: Housing
en.summary: Guidance must separate practical search steps from rights that vary by state and city, with verification before payment.

ht.title: Etid
ht.summary: Lekòl, ekivalans ak èd finansye bezwen sous ofisyèl pa eta ak pa enstitisyon.

en.title: Education
en.summary: School enrollment, credential recognition and financial aid require official state and institution sources.

ht.title: Sante
ht.summary: Pa bay rekòmandasyon medikal. Verifye ijans, asirans ak sèvis lokal yo nan sous ofisyèl aktyèl.

en.title: Health
en.summary: Do not provide medical recommendations. Verify emergency, insurance and local service information with current official sources.

ht.title: Premye 30 jou
ht.summary: Verifye dosye ofisyèl ki aplike pou ou, konsève avi yo, pwoteje dokiman yo epi verifye nenpòt moun anvan ou peye.

en.title: First 30 days
en.summary: Check the official records that apply to you, keep notices, protect documents and verify anyone before paying.

ht.title: Magouy ak risk
ht.summary: Verifye pwofesyonèl yo nan lis ofisyèl yo. Pa sipoze yon notè, ajan vwayaj oswa konsiltan gen otorizasyon pou bay konsèy legal.

en.title: Scams and risks
en.summary: Verify professionals in official rosters. Do not assume a notary, travel agent or consultant is authorized to provide legal advice.

ht.title: Sèvis
ht.summary: Pa gen sèvis pou vann jiskaske limit, pri, SLA, ranbousman ak wòl pwofesyonèl yo apwouve.

en.title: Services
en.summary: No service is offered for sale until scope, price, SLA, refunds and professional roles are approved.

ht.title: Sous
ht.summary: Senk pwen depa ofisyèl yo verifye nan dat ki ekri anlè a; itilizatè a dwe tcheke sous la ankò anvan li aji.

en.title: Sources
en.summary: Five official starting points were checked on the recorded date; users should recheck the source before acting.
